title: viola montana var. elatior
intro: Viola montana var. elatior, commonly known as a perennial plant species, is a member of the violet family (Violaceae). This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cognitive function, and supporting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Viola montana var. elatior include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
